The tests/unit/macacfs/projinit.bats file boundary: bats tests with fake br/ee/cm/ntm/slb/ms CLIs on a shadow PATH proving status detection (initialized/missing/unavailable), that projinit initializes only missing desired tools and is a no-op on a second run, --json shape, --save-defaults writing newproj.tools, unknown tool ids rejected, and that classic 'newproj --tools' and '--no-tools' initialize exactly the chosen set.
